from pathlib import Path
import hashlib,json,os,re,statistics,subprocess,sys,time
root=Path('/home/andrew-peterson/.codex/worktrees/stdlib-foundation/laniusc');os.chdir(root)
p=root/'tests/fixtures/stdlib_compiler_state/parameter-scoped-graphs';out=p/('performance-contracts' if sys.argv[3]=='contracts' else 'performance-ordinary');out.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
version=sys.argv[1];index=sys.argv[2]
h=json.loads((p/'frozen-sources.json').read_text());changed=lambda:[f for f,v in h.items() if not Path(f).is_file() or hashlib.sha256(Path(f).read_bytes()).hexdigest()!=v];assert not changed(),changed()
link=root/'target/stdlib-perf/build/laniusc-shader-artifacts/release/shaders';assert link.is_symlink();original=os.readlink(link);tmp=link.with_name('contract-perf-shaders.tmp');assert not tmp.exists()
binary=root/'target/contract-snapshot-complete-baseline/stdlib_gpu_perf'
fixture,expected=('tests/fixtures/stdlib_compiler_state/trait-type-graphs/thirty-two-mixed.lani','-') if sys.argv[3]=='contracts' else ('tests/fixtures/stdlib_foundation/generic_many_parameter_composition_32.lani','benchmark_artifacts/performance/stdlib-gpu-20261010-implementation-evidence/generic-32.expected.txt')
args=[str(binary),fixture,'stdlib',expected,'3','10']
log=out/f'{index}-{version}.log';start=time.monotonic()
try:
    if version=='baseline':
        tmp.symlink_to(root/'target/contract-snapshot-complete-baseline/shaders');os.replace(tmp,link)
    with log.open('w') as f:
        try: code=subprocess.run(args,env={**os.environ,'LANIUS_PERF_REBUILD_ENTRY':'1'},stdout=f,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,timeout=90).returncode
        except subprocess.TimeoutExpired: code=124
finally:
    if version=='baseline': tmp.symlink_to(original);os.replace(tmp,link)
raw=log.read_text();samples=[float(x) for x in re.findall(r'^sample=\d+ ms=([\d.]+)$',raw,re.M)]
r={'version':version,'command':args,'environment':{'LANIUS_PERF_REBUILD_ENTRY':'1'},'exit_code':code,'elapsed_seconds':time.monotonic()-start,'binary_sha256':hashlib.sha256(binary.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'samples_ms':samples,'median_ms':statistics.median(samples) if samples else None,'output_verified':'output_verified=true' in raw,'sources_unchanged':not changed(),'shader_link_restored':os.readlink(link)==original}
(out/f'{index}-{version}.json').write_text(json.dumps(r,indent=2)+'\n');print(json.dumps(r,indent=2));print(raw[-1100:])

assert code==0 and len(samples)==10 and r['output_verified'] and r['sources_unchanged'] and r['shader_link_restored'], r
